title: kith-events test couples events crate to kith-store via dev-dependency
description: kith-events/Cargo.toml lists kith-store as a dev-dependency so the test test_store_set_events_tx (lib.rs line 75) can call kith_store::Store::open_in_memory(). This means compiling kith-events tests transitively compiles kith-store and its bundled rusqlite, adding significant build time. The test exercises that Store.events_tx changes from None to Some after set_events_tx, which is a property of kith-store, not kith-events. This test belongs in kith-store, not kith-events. Moving it would eliminate the cross-crate dev-dep.
